```{r setup, include=F}
# Load libs
library(xfun)
pkg_attach("here", "tidyverse", "ggeffects", "lme4", "lmerTest", "car", "emmeans", "scales", "broom", "broom.mixed", "colorBlindness", "interactions", "patchwork", install = T)
options(scipen=999)
here::i_am("code/BehavioralMainAnalyses_Figures.Rmd") # project root is `ugr-emoreg`
```

# Loading data
Loading in the trial-level .csv (one row per trial) and the subject-level .csv (participant demographic, EROS scores, derived behavioral sensitivity to fairness as used in neural analyses, and extracted neuroimaging values). If you have any questions about the data/setup, please email!
```{r}
# Load data
full_df <- read_csv(here("data", "Kos_triallevel_df.csv")) # trial-level
df <- read_csv(here("data", "Kos_sublevel_df.csv")) # subject-level

# Exclude runs missing 25%+ of responses (12+ responses missed)
run_response <- full_df |>
  filter(!is.na(accept)) |> # (should be empty/no missed trials used for beh. fairness sensitivity anyway)
  group_by(sub_id, run) |> 
  summarise(n_responded = n_distinct(nTrial), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(prop_missed = 1 - n_responded/48)
excluded_runs <- run_response |> filter(prop_missed > .25) 
excluded_runs # expect 10954 run 1, 11316 run 2

full_df <- semi_join(full_df, filter(run_response, prop_missed <= .25), by = c("sub_id", "run"))

# Trial-level behavioral accept/reject variables 
full_df <- full_df |>
  mutate(beh_fairness = offer / endowment,
         # Percentage label for plot
         beh_fairness_perc = case_when(beh_fairness >= 0.060 & beh_fairness <= 0.0625 ~ "5%", 
                                       beh_fairness >= 0.09375 & beh_fairness <= 0.125 ~ "10%", 
                                       abs(beh_fairness - 0.25) < 0.000001 ~ "25%", 
                                       abs(beh_fairness - 0.50) < 0.000001 ~ "50%",
                                       TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         # Numeric binned version for models (5 and 10% offers were rounded to whole dollars)
         beh_fairness_num = case_when(beh_fairness_perc == "5%" ~ 0.05, 
                                      beh_fairness_perc == "10%" ~ 0.10, 
                                      beh_fairness_perc == "25%" ~ 0.25, 
                                      beh_fairness_perc == "50%" ~ 0.50,
                                      TRUE ~ NA_real_),
         # Factor version for plot
         beh_fairness_perc = factor(beh_fairness_perc, levels = c("5%", "10%", "25%", "50%")))

# Mean center subject-level covars and EROS scores
df <- df |>
  mutate(sub_age_MC = sub_age - mean(sub_age), 
         fd_mean_MC = fd_mean - mean(fd_mean), 
         tsnr_MC = tsnr - mean(tsnr), 
         ext_bet_c = ext_bet - mean(ext_bet), 
         ext_wor_c = ext_wor - mean(ext_wor),
         int_bet_c = int_bet - mean(int_bet),
         int_wor_c = int_wor - mean(int_wor))
nrow(full_df) # 12430 trials
nrow(df) # 138 subs
```

# Behavioral sensitivity to fairness calculation
The 4 different slopes for sensitivities to fairness based on the behavioral data: all-trial, social trials only, nonsocial trials only, then the difference scored social - nonsocial. 

The slopes saved in the subject-level .csv are the values used as covariates in the FSL group models, so those are also used for all analyses below so that neural and behavioral results are aligned. 

The slopes are recomputed here for methods transparency. The output for diff_slope is nearly identical values (r > .995) but not exact, same for slope_all (r > .999); difference may be due to updated R packages/estimation noise...
```{r}
## Sensitivity to fairness
# Function to extract sub-level fairness slope
get_fairness_slope <- function(df, label) {
  # Fixed effect of behavioral fairness (% of endowment in decimal form), random slope and intercept by subject
  model <- glmer(accept ~ beh_fairness_num + (1 + beh_fairness_num | sub_id), data = df, family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  fe <- fixef(model)[["beh_fairness_num"]] 
  re <- ranef(model)$sub_id[, "beh_fairness_num"]
  subjIDs <- as.numeric(rownames(ranef(model)$sub_id)) 
  tibble(sub_id = subjIDs, !!label := fe + re)
}

# Recompute S>NS slopes used as covars in FSL analyses (overall, social only, and nonsocial only slopes); diff_slope = social - nonsocial
slope_check <- get_fairness_slope(full_df, "slope_all") |>
  left_join(get_fairness_slope(filter(full_df, condition == "social"),    "slope_social"),    by = "sub_id") |>
  left_join(get_fairness_slope(filter(full_df, condition == "nonsocial"), "slope_nonsocial"), by = "sub_id") |>
  mutate(diff_slope = slope_social - slope_nonsocial)

# Compare against the saved diff_slope (saved diff_slope was used in FSL group-level analyses)
saved <- df |> distinct(sub_id, slope_all, slope_social, slope_nonsocial, diff_slope)
cmp   <- left_join(slope_check, saved, by = "sub_id", suffix = c("_new", "_saved"))

# Correlation, mean, SD, max differences between diff_slope used in neural analyses and output from here
# Looks at all 4 slopes
sapply(c("slope_all", "slope_social", "slope_nonsocial", "diff_slope"), function(v) {
  new <- cmp[[paste0(v, "_new")]]
  old <- cmp[[paste0(v, "_saved")]]
  d <- new - old
  c(r = cor(new, old, use = "complete.obs"), mean_diff = mean(d, na.rm = TRUE), sd_diff = sd(d, na.rm = TRUE), 
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(d), na.rm = TRUE), sd_saved = sd(old, na.rm = TRUE))
})

# Saved slopes (used in FSL) and new slopes (just computed)
cmp |>
  select(sub_id, slope_all_saved, slope_all_new, 
         slope_social_saved, slope_social_new, 
         slope_nonsocial_saved, slope_nonsocial_new,
         diff_slope_saved, diff_slope_new) |>
  head(15) |> print(digits = 3, width = Inf)
```

# Behavioral Analyses
## Acceptance Rate (Figure 1)
Looking at the acceptance rate for offers across the 4 levels of fairness. In particular, want to see if there is a significant difference in 1) fairness on offer acceptance and 2) fairness and social context (human vs. computer partner) on offer acceptance.
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Model without condition
fairness <- glmer(accept ~ beh_fairness_num + (1 | sub_id), data = full_df, family = binomial,
                  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
summary(fairness)

# Model with condition
fairness_condition <- glmer(accept ~ beh_fairness_num * condition + (1 | sub_id), data = full_df, family = binomial, 
                            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
summary(fairness_condition)

# Summarise with SE and put "social" first
plot_df <- full_df |>
  group_by(beh_fairness_perc, condition) |>
  summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
            accept_rate = mean(accept, na.rm = T), 
            sd_accept = sd(accept, na.rm = T),
            se_accept = sd_accept / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("social", "nonsocial")), 
         ymin = pmax(0, accept_rate - se_accept),
         ymax = pmin(1, accept_rate + se_accept))

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)  # shared dodge object

# Figure 1B
p_fig1b <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = beh_fairness_perc, y = accept_rate, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
           linetype = "solid",
           color = "lightgray",
           linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.15, position = pd, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Acceptance Rate", 
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
                     labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Offer Fairness (% of endowment)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("social" = "#FBB03B", "nonsocial" = "#50C9F1"), breaks = c("social", "nonsocial")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 24) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 15), axis.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.title = element_blank()) 
p_fig1b
```
Significant for offer fairness, but not the interaction term. 

## Response time and offer fairness (for supplemental)
Checking whether response time is strongly correlated with offer fairness, since shared variance with the RT regressor could underestimate the parametric fairness effect.
```{r}
rt_clean <- full_df |>
  filter(!is.na(rt), rt > 0) 
nrow(rt_clean)
summary(rt_clean$rt) # sanity: should sit under the 3.25s decision window

# a) within-sub corrs, fisher-z averagde
ws_r <- rt_clean |>
  group_by(sub_id) |>
  summarise(r = cor(beh_fairness_num, rt), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(z = atanh(pmin(pmax(r, -.999), .999)))
ws_r |> summarise(n = n(), mean_r = tanh(mean(z)), sd_r = sd(r),
                  min_r = min(r), max_r = max(r), 
                  t = mean(z)/(sd(z)/sqrt(n())), 
                  p = 2*pt(-abs(t), n()-1))
t.test(ws_r$r)   # untransformed

# b) monotonic in fairness, or slowest at intermediate offers?
rt_clean |>
  group_by(beh_fairness_perc) |>
  summarise(M = mean(rt), SD = sd(rt), n = n())

# Tukey
emmeans(lmer(rt ~ beh_fairness_perc + (1 | sub_id), data = rt_clean), pairwise ~ beh_fairness_perc)
```

## AINs categorical plot (Figure 3)
Using data from the categorical model in FSL (model 3b, level 1 = 5% offer, and so on) to demonstrate the anterior insula tracking offer fairness regardless of low or high endowment amount. Values (ains_) and varcopes (ains_varcope_) extracted from AIns mask, one column per partner and offer level (pt = % of endowment).
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Long format, one row per sub x condition
cat_stats_df <- df |>
  select(sub_id, starts_with("ains_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-sub_id, names_to = c("stat", "social", "level"),
               names_pattern = "ains_(varcope_)?(social|nonsocial)_(\\d+)pt") |>
  mutate(stat = ifelse(stat == "", "value", "varcope"),
         social = ifelse(social == "nonsocial", "Nonsocial", "Social"),
         level = factor(paste0(level, "%"), levels = c("5%", "10%", "25%", "50%"))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value)

# Weighted means and SEMs
cat_plot_df <- cat_stats_df |>
  group_by(social, level) |>
  summarise(mean = sum(value / varcope) / sum(1 / varcope), sem = sqrt(1 / sum(1 / varcope)), .groups = "drop")

# Figure 3B
p_fig3b <- ggplot(cat_plot_df, aes(x = level, y = mean, fill = social)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-15, -10, -5, 0, 5), 
           linetype = "solid", color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, 
                    ymax = mean + sem), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth=0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Social" = "#FBB03B", "Nonsocial" = "#50C9F1")) + 
  labs(x = "Offer Level (% of endowment)",
       y = "AIns activation (inverse-variance weighted mean)",
       title = "Anterior Insula – Social vs Nonsocial") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p_fig3b
```

# Activation
## dlPFC, S > NS behavioral sensitivity, Extrinsic Affect Improving (Other-Directed Affect Improving) (Figure 4, Supplemental Figure 4)
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Create High/Low grouping by median split
df$ext_bet_group <- ifelse(df$ext_bet >= median(df$ext_bet), "High", "Low")

# 12-color color-blind friendly palette
cb_palette <- SteppedSequential5Steps

# Choose colors
cb_pair <- cb_palette[c(3, 11)]
names(cb_pair) <- c("Low", "High")

# Regression scatterplot with colorblind-safe palette and residualized Y (Supp. Figure 4)
p_dlPFC_extbet <- ggplot(df, aes(
  x = diff_slope, 
  y = residuals(lm(dlpfc_extbet ~ sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male + fd_mean_MC + tsnr_MC)),
  color = ext_bet_group,
  fill = ext_bet_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 3) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cb_pair) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cb_pair) +
  labs(
    x = "Behavioral Sensitivity to Fairness, \nSocial > Nonsocial", 
    y = "Neural Sensitivity to Fairness, \nSocial > Nonsocial (Residualized)",
    color = "Extrinsic Affect-Improving", 
    fill = "Extrinsic Affect-Improving") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
p_dlPFC_extbet

# Johnson-Neyman plot version (Figure 4B)
m_jn <- lm(dlpfc_extbet ~ diff_slope * ext_bet + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male + fd_mean_MC + tsnr_MC, data = df)
summary(m_jn)

# Observed range of moderator
mf <- model.frame(m_jn)
mod_rng <- range(mf$ext_bet, na.rm = T)

# Johnson–Neyman analysis
jn <- johnson_neyman(m_jn, 
  pred = "diff_slope",
  modx = "ext_bet",
  alpha = 0.05,
  mod.range = mod_rng, 
  sig.color = cb_palette[11],
  insig.color = "gray",
  line.thickness = 1,
  y.label = "Slope of Sensitivity to Fairness, Social > Nonsocial",
  modx.label = "Extrinsic Affect-Improving", 
  title = "Activation, dlPFC, Extrinsic Affect-Improving")
jn
```

## EROS moderation of fairness sensitivity (trial-level) (Figure 2)
```{r figure-2, fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
eros_cols <- c("Other-Directed Emotion Improving" = "green3",
               "Other-Directed Emotion Worsening" = "red2",
               "Self-Directed Emotion Improving"  = "goldenrod2",
               "Self-Directed Emotion Worsening"  = "blue2")

# Z-score fairness and add mean-centered EROS scores to the trial-level df
full_df$fair_z <- scale(full_df$beh_fairness)[,1]
  full_df <- full_df |> select(-any_of(c("ext_bet_c", "ext_wor_c", "int_bet_c", "int_wor_c"))) |>
    left_join(select(df, sub_id, ext_bet_c, ext_wor_c, int_bet_c, int_wor_c), by = "sub_id")
fair_mean <- mean(full_df$beh_fairness, na.rm = T)
fair_sd <- sd(full_df$beh_fairness, na.rm = T)

# EROS moderation of fairness x offer acceptance relationship (all trials)
fair_extbet <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * ext_bet_c + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                     control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
fair_extwor <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * ext_wor_c + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df, 
                     control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
fair_intbet <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * int_bet_c + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                     control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
fair_intwor <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * int_wor_c + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                     control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
summary(fair_extbet)
summary(fair_extwor)
summary(fair_intbet)
summary(fair_intwor)

# EROS moderation of fairness x offer acceptance relationship (social vs. nonsocial trials)
fair_extwor_cond <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * ext_wor_c * condition + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
summary(fair_extwor_cond)$coefficients["fair_z:ext_wor_c:conditionsocial", ]

fair_extbet_cond <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * ext_bet_c * condition + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
fair_intbet_cond <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * int_bet_c * condition + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
fair_intwor_cond <- glmer(accept ~ fair_z * int_wor_c * condition + (1 + fair_z | sub_id), family = binomial, data = full_df,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))

cond_p <- c(ext_bet = summary(fair_extbet_cond)$coefficients["fair_z:ext_bet_c:conditionsocial", 4],
            ext_wor = summary(fair_extwor_cond)$coefficients["fair_z:ext_wor_c:conditionsocial", 4],
            int_bet = summary(fair_intbet_cond)$coefficients["fair_z:int_bet_c:conditionsocial", 4],
            int_wor = summary(fair_intwor_cond)$coefficients["fair_z:int_wor_c:conditionsocial", 4])
cond_p
p.adjust(cond_p, "bonferroni")

# Vars to use for plot
eros_vars <- c("ext_bet_c", "ext_wor_c", "int_bet_c", "int_wor_c")

fig2_df <- list(fair_extbet, fair_extwor, fair_intbet, fair_intwor) |>
  set_names(eros_vars) |>
  imap_dfr(\(m, v) broom.mixed::tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) |> # Wald 95% CIs
             filter(term == paste0("fair_z:", v)) |>
             mutate(var = v)) |>
  mutate(sd_sub   = map_dbl(sub("_c$", "", var), \(r) sd(df[[r]])),
         est_sd   = estimate  * sd_sub,
         low_sd   = conf.low  * sd_sub,
         high_sd  = conf.high * sd_sub,
         p_bonf   = p.adjust(p.value, "bonferroni"),
         EROS_scale = factor(names(eros_cols)[match(var, eros_vars)], levels = rev(names(eros_cols))))

print(select(fig2_df, EROS_scale, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_bonf, est_sd), digits = 4)

# Figure 2
# Panel A: forest plot, per SD of each subscale
x_lim <- max(abs(c(fig2_df$low_sd, fig2_df$high_sd))) * 1.1

p_fig2a <- ggplot(fig2_df, aes(x = est_sd, y = EROS_scale, color = EROS_scale)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = low_sd, xmax = high_sd), linewidth = 1.6, size = 1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.03, y = 0.4, label = "Fairness matters less", hjust = 1, size = 5.5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x =  0.03, y = 0.4, label = "Fairness matters more", hjust = 0, size = 5.5, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim), breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.9, 0.5))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = eros_cols, breaks = names(eros_cols), name = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.6, size = 1.2))) +
  labs(x = "Effect of a 1-SD higher EROS score\non fairness sensitivity (log-odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length.x = unit(5, "pt"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(4, "pt"),
        legend.key.height = unit(14, "pt"),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"))

# Panel B: predicted acceptance, other-directed emotion worsening
# Typical participant (random effects = 0), at the four offer levels, for the
# scale minimum, the mean, and +1 SD (-1 SD would fall below the scale minimum of 1).
offers <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50)
offers_z <- round((offers - fair_mean) / fair_sd, 4)

eaw_center <- mean(df$ext_wor)
eaw_raw <- c(1.00, eaw_center, eaw_center + sd(df$ext_wor))
eaw_labs <- sprintf(c("%.2f (scale minimum)", "%.2f (mean)", "%.2f (+1 SD)"), eaw_raw)

pred_eaw <- ggpredict(
  fair_extwor,
  terms = c(sprintf("fair_z [%s]", paste(offers_z, collapse = ",")),
            sprintf("ext_wor_c [%s]", paste(round(eaw_raw - eaw_center, 4), collapse = ",")))) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(offer = x * fair_sd + fair_mean,
         eaw = factor(as.numeric(as.character(group)), labels = eaw_labs))

eaw_cols <- setNames(c("red2", "black", "red4"), eaw_labs)

p_fig2b <- ggplot(pred_eaw, aes(x = offer, y = predicted, color = eaw, fill = eaw)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = eaw_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eaw_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous("Offer (% of endowment)", breaks = offers,
                     labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Predicted probability of accepting",
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
                     labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(color = "Other-directed emotion worsening:", fill = "Other-directed emotion worsening:") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length.x = unit(5, "pt"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(4, "pt"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"))

# Combine
p_fig2 <- p_fig2a + p_fig2b + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
p_fig2
```

## Subject-specific fairness slopes (Supplemental Figure 2)
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# All trials
ext_bet_all <- lm(slope_all ~ ext_bet_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df)
ext_wor_all <- lm(slope_all ~ ext_wor_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df)
int_bet_all <- lm(slope_all ~ int_bet_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df)
int_wor_all <- lm(slope_all ~ int_wor_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df)
summary(ext_bet_all)
summary(ext_wor_all)
summary(int_bet_all)
summary(int_wor_all)

# Multiple comparisons correction across 4 subscales
all_p <- c(ext_bet = summary(ext_bet_all)$coefficients["ext_bet_c", 4],
           ext_wor = summary(ext_wor_all)$coefficients["ext_wor_c", 4],
           int_bet = summary(int_bet_all)$coefficients["int_bet_c", 4],
           int_wor = summary(int_wor_all)$coefficients["int_wor_c", 4])
p.adjust(all_p, method = "bonferroni")
p.adjust(all_p, method = "BH")

# S>NS difference
summary(lm(diff_slope ~ ext_bet_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df))
summary(lm(diff_slope ~ ext_wor_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df))
summary(lm(diff_slope ~ int_bet_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df))
summary(lm(diff_slope ~ int_wor_c + sub_age_MC + gender_female + gender_male, df))

df_long <- df |>
  select(slope_all, ext_bet, ext_wor, int_bet, int_wor) |>
  pivot_longer(-slope_all, names_to = "EROS_scale", values_to = "score")

df_long$EROS_scale <- factor(df_long$EROS_scale,
  levels = c("ext_bet", "ext_wor", "int_bet", "int_wor"),
  labels = c("Other-Directed Emotion Improving", "Other-Directed Emotion Worsening", "Self-Directed Emotion Improving", "Self-Directed Emotion Worsening"))

# Supp Figure 2: Subject-specific sensitivity to fairness  EROS
# Lines are simple fits; stats above are from the models controlling for age and gender
p_supp_fairness_slope_eros <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = score, y = slope_all)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = EROS_scale, fill = EROS_scale),
    method = "lm",
    se = T,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ EROS_scale, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = eros_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eros_cols) +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "EROS Subscale Score",
    y = "Sensitivity to Fairness") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18)
p_supp_fairness_slope_eros
```

## Distribution of EROS subscale scores (Supplemental figure 3)
```{r}
eros_long <- df |>
  select(ext_bet, ext_wor, int_bet, int_wor) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "EROS_scale", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(EROS_scale = factor(EROS_scale,
    levels = c("ext_bet", "ext_wor", "int_bet", "int_wor"),
    labels = names(eros_cols)))

jn_lines <- tibble(EROS_scale = factor(c("Other-Directed Emotion Improving", "Other-Directed Emotion Improving",
                        "Other-Directed Emotion Worsening", "Other-Directed Emotion Worsening"),
                      levels = names(eros_cols)),
  cutoff = c(3.42, 4.13, 1.15, 1.52))

p_supp_eros_hist <- ggplot(eros_long, aes(x = score, fill = EROS_scale)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(data = jn_lines, aes(xintercept = cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray10") +
  facet_wrap(~ EROS_scale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eros_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), breaks = 1:5) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = "EROS subscale score", y = "Number of participants") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5))
p_supp_eros_hist

# For figure captions, how many subs in significant regions
df |> summarise(eai_high = sum(ext_bet > 4.13), eai_mid = sum(ext_bet >= 3.42 & ext_bet <= 4.13), eai_low = sum(ext_bet < 3.42),
                eaw_high = sum(ext_wor > 1.52), eaw_mid = sum(ext_wor >= 1.15 & ext_wor <= 1.52), eaw_low = sum(ext_wor < 1.15))
```
